title: SHILL.WTF
tagline: A meme launchpad powered by a decntralized twitter marketing flywheel mechanism (shiller rewarded from trading volume fees) and pre mint campaign. Meme shillers are rewarded at the time of mint with from the minted supply based on objective performance.

prizes.title: Best Overall Use Case or Research with ZK Email

description:
A meme launchpad powered by a verifiable twitter shiller impact, ushering a new era of combining web2 identities and data with web3 programmability and tokenization. An experiment in decentralized marketing. 

The flywheel mechanism comes from a continuous marketing campaign where the fees from the trading volume is given back to the shill fund. Every week (an epoch) new scores are calculated and rewards distributed based on performance! 

So shillers are rewarded in Phase1 (premint) with x% of supply and then in phase2 from the flywheel shill funds. 

Shillers register by proving they own a zkemail twitter NFT. 

The Meme Cycle in shill.xyz: 
0. Shillers register their twitter ID to a wallet address using the ZK email NFT 
1. Marketing phase (pre mint) 
rules are specified by the new Meme minter: (views formula: points = views ^0.625) + anti sybil (top 5 tweets per user, min 50 views per tweet, user needs min 10 followers) + how much of token supply will go to shillers.  
2. Meme Token Launch on bonding curve (fair launch)  + DEX
At time of mint shillers get their pre agreed on  percentage of tokens. They are rewarded based on their objective performance
3. FlyWheel: The bonding curve + DEX will have 0.3% fees for LP + 0.3% for the "shill fund" which is given back to shillers based on weekly epochs. 

Shill.xyz as a project:
- will handle the twitter data APIs and charge per campaign fees to cover cost of admin and offchain services. 
- add more youtube.com, tiktok, ...etc. 
- add more granularity to campaign rules
how_its_made:
The project uses twitter apis
next.js for frontend application 
python for retrieving the twitter api data 
ShillCore contract handles logic. It handles the claiming of funds, the ending of epochs . 

Will be deployed on Base as a starting point. 

The DEX pool is a univ4 pool with hooks
